rows.reasoning: On HB2241 (2021) she is the prime sponsor and voted Aye, and the chaptered text requires "that students be taught about the Holocaust and other genocides at least twice between the seventh and TWELFTH grades". That is a required-curriculum mandate on one named historical injustice, narrower than "an honest account of racism, injustice, and diverse identities as part of the core curriculum", so it shows the side without matching that rung's clauses (V4.2 "Broader than the instrument"; the vote is also near-unanimous at 59-0).
